crossRefs.note: For as the earth produces its bud, and as the garden causes the things that are sown in it to spring up, so the Lord…
For the earth bears fruit: first the blade, then the ear, then the full grain in the ear.
For as the rain comes down and the snow from the sky, and doesn’t return there, but waters the earth, and makes it grow…
so is my word that goes out of my mouth: it will not return to me void, but it will accomplish that which I please, and…
He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field,
For each tree is known by its own fruit. For people don’t gather figs from thorns, nor do they gather grapes from a…
Now may he who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food, supply and multiply your seed for sowing, and increase…
Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.

translations.web: The earth yielded grass, herbs yielding seed after their kind, and trees bearing fruit, with their seeds in it, after their kind; and God saw that it was good.
translations.bsb: The earth produced vegetation: seed-bearing plants according to their kinds and trees bearing fruit with seed according to their kinds. And God saw that it was good.
translations.kjv: And the earth brought forth grass, and herb yielding seed after his kind, and the tree yielding fruit, whose seed was in itself, after his kind: and God saw that it was good.
translations.asv: And the earth brought forth grass, herbs yielding seed after their kind, and trees bearing fruit, wherein is the seed thereof, after their kind: and God saw that it was good.
